## About us 

 Stanwell is Queensland’s leading provider of electricity and energy solutions to the National Electricity Market and large energy users along the eastern seaboard of Australia. With over 40 years of continuous operations, Stanwell maintains a reliable supply of power from two of the most efficient coal-fired power stations in Australia – the Tarong power stations near Kingaroy and Stanwell Power Station near Rockhampton. Stanwell’s experience working with communities to build, operate and maintain reliable coal-fired power stations is also being applied through partnerships with the private sector to build the new energy, storage and firming solutions Queensland needs for the future. Stanwell is an energy employer for everyone. We foster an inclusive and diverse environment where everyone is embraced and respected. Our values - We care, We adapt and We deliver - are the foundation of our culture and underpin our success. Stanwell welcomes respectful and constructive engagement on our social media channels. We reserve the right to remove comments that are offensive, defamatory, spam, or otherwise inappropriate. Our channels are not monitored 24/7, and we may not respond to all comments or messages. For enquiries or feedback, please contact us directly via info@stanwell.com. Thank you for being part of our online community.

Seven years in the making, a special new space for culture, connection and community has officially opened at Kingaroy State High School. The school’s new yarning circle, surrounded by bush tucker plants, native trees and a vibrant mural, was brought to life through the hard work of students, volunteers and the wider school community. A smoking ceremony marked the official opening of the space, which will give students, families and community members a welcoming place to gather and strengthen connections to Country and community. We’re proud to have supported this meaningful project through Stanwell’s Tarong Community Sponsorship Program. #Stanwell #Tarong #Community #Kingaroy #SouthBurnett
